headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4 in a thrilling matchup, with Zack Wheeler pitching 7 strong innings for the Phillies. The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, led by Willson Contreras' 2 hits, including his 12th home run of the season. The New York Yankees took down the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, securing a crucial win behind Brent Headrick's strong performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Aaron Judge has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right rib stress fracture, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026. Jonathan India has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left shoulder subluxation. Trevor Story has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a sports hernia. Sean Murphy has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a fractured left middle finger. Joe Mantiply has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left knee inflammation. Travis d'Arnaud has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right foot plantar fasciitis. Matt Gage has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 2, 2026, with right knee inflammation. Rob Zastryzny has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, with a left trapezius strain.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. LHP Joe La Sorsa has been traded to the Boston Red Sox. RHP Kyle Nicolas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. C Austin Wynns has been traded to the Atlanta Braves for cash. RHP Simeon Woods Richardson has been traded to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. RHP Justin Lawrence has been traded to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Phillies in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4, securing a crucial win. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched 7 strong innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, led by a strong performance from their offense. Willson Contreras led the charge with 2 hits, including his 12th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, securing a crucial win. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar closed out the game with a save.

top_news.title: **Giants Outlast Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants took down the Milwaukee Brewers 12-9, securing a hard-fought win. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Aaron Judge Placed on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Yankees right fielder Aaron Judge has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right rib stress fracture, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **La Sorsa Joins Red Sox**
top_news.summary: LHP Joe La Sorsa has been traded to the Boston Red Sox. The trade marks La Sorsa's new affiliation with the team.
